data.narrative:
Transmutex is a Series A nuclear energy company founded by Franklin Servan-Schreiber, Federico Carminati, and Jean-Pierre Revol. The company has raised $23M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 11 frontier nuclear peers: 3 public companies (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private firms including Fuse Energy, X-Energy, Oklo, and Nano Nuclear Energy.

The Peer-Median method was not applicable due to insufficient comparable datapoints at the same stage and valuation tier within the nuclear sector. Instead, the Stage-Progression method was applied, using the $23M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a standard 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A advancement. This method yielded an implied valuation of $46M.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $39M to $53M, with a median of $46M. This range reflects the single applicable triangulation method and carries material uncertainty due to the narrow peer set available for cross-validation in early-stage nuclear technology. Key risks to valuation include regulatory pathway clarity, technology demonstration milestones, and the emerging competitive landscape in advanced nuclear. Investors should treat this range as preliminary pending deeper operational due diligence.
